reviews.title: There are better options to share photos
reviews.text: We got added to using this app by our school and I want to encourage anyone thinking of using it to find an alternative. This app randomly shows full screen undismissable videos for gambling ads and who knows what else.

reviews.title: Video limit
reviews.text: If you get photo circle for free then there is a 1 min video limit like if I wanted to post a 30min video then I would have to do 30 different clips

reviews.title: Horrible ads
reviews.text: This app works pretty well but many of the ads are very inappropriate!!! And be sure not to accidentally click any of them or it may take you to a scammy website. Is this a way of forcing me to pay for no ads?

reviews.title: Now requires iOS 16. My old tablet maxed out at 15+
reviews.text: This app has upgraded beyond my ability to use it on my iPad. The forced update won’t run so I have no other option but to uninstall. Why not leave a copy of the old app available, with security caveats, or whatever? Or make a web version; I use other former apps on Safari, e.g. eBay, AirBNB, now my old tablet isn’t supported by the app. EDIT: instead of answering my question, the reply just told me what I already know: my iPad is extremely old. However, many apps do still work on it and, more to the point, IT STILL WORKS! Obsolescence by update should be banned, especially if the user has purchased the app (I hadn’t).

reviews.title: Need to be more transparent
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and was immediately charged. It’s not forthcoming to not be upfront about the cost of the app. Not only does it cost more than 10 dollars, you still have ads involved in the app.

reviews.title: Excessive Notifications
reviews.text: Signed up through an invite from my child’s teacher. Getting notifications literally every few minutes when each new parent joins the class.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: There’s no option to select full photo albums or select all. Or even to hold and highlight groupings of photos to upload. Each must be clicked on in the corner only, to be added. Waste of time

reviews.title: Trash company
reviews.text: I clicked a link to a rally for photos and I was banned from using the app due to other people on the link posting pics. I never made the first post and contacted customer service and they refused to reinstate me to use the app. Ridiculous and unlogical that you would banned someone who did nothing wrong.

reviews.title: So upset
reviews.text: I put all of my pictures into their system and all of a sudden my information is gone. Horrible contact system in place. Text and go an automated response but still nothing. So if you’re thinking about using this platform, make sure you’re storing pictures you afford to lose.

reviews.title: Great app, super Fun!!
reviews.text:
I am super happy with this app! I love getting to communicate with my friends using photos and Videos! My parents don’t allow me to have any social media and I love this because it is super helpful and very fun to use, and not everyone in the world can see what you are doing! I really love this app and I recommend it! It’s really safe and and I love to reading comments on photos and 👍🏼ing photos, and one of my favorites is the videos! And a lot of Reviews were talking about how the adds were annoying, you just have to swipe right through them it is not hard at all! Also about the adds there is not a specific time you have you just swipe it and it is over, if that makes sense. I really love Photo Circle and I do recommend it!

reviews.title: Ads were too much
reviews.text: It’s a shame, I liked the functionality and look of this app more than Cluster which I’m sticking to now. I wanted to use this app to share travel photos with family and friends so they can see what I’m up to whilst I move abroad. However you can only pay to remove the ads for your own account. I’d actually happily pay as a one off to remove ads for people looking at my album but that’s not an option, they have to pay themselves. When I first downloaded the app there wasn’t ads but a week or so in they pop up every time I use the app and often you have to close it down to get rid of the ad. I didn’t want my family having the same experience especially if they are less tech savvy
